title: Wrong Design Intent Can Be Worse Than None: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
abstract: Fine-tuned code LLMs are often conditioned on a design-intent header to steer parametric CAD generation, but whether the model reads that header's content has been tested neither under execution-level scoring nor with a causal control. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style sketch-extrude programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, re-scored by executable geometric assertions on the produced B-rep solid. Across three seeds and a pre-registered {0%, 40%}-prefix $\times$ {correct, wrong, masked}-header matrix -- with inference duplicate-aware over the 38 unique-program clusters a submission-stage audit found held out -- we report: (i) in conditional completion (40% prefix), a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the no-header baseline (0.43 $\to$ 0.30/0.21 text/token) on the intents the model can render unconditioned, namely polygonal and thin. The drop is significant on 3/3 token-header seeds but 1/3 text-header seeds, so the pre-registered combined rule, which required the text side, does not pass; (ii) a derangement control -- retrained with shuffled headers: identical marginal, greatly reduced content correlation -- stays competent yet shows no detectable correct-to-wrong drop while M does (text headers; interaction significant on 3/3 seeds, p $\le$ 0.024, one seed below the frozen non-zero-count guardrail), so the harm requires the learned header$\to$program mapping, not the header marginal; (iii) requiring a generated program to execute removes almost all of a correct header's apparent benefit (token: +0.22 ungated regex $\to$ +0.03 gated regex $\to$ +0.02 gated geometry), so the deflation is execution blindness, not detector disagreement; (iv) the harm is regime-specific: at 0% prefix the baseline generates no valid CAD at all. Wrong intent is not noise: where it is detectable, it actively misdirects generation.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2607.23191v2 全文整理；论文 PDF 明确提供公开代码 URL。
analysis.ideaZh: CADCON 用 executable B-rep assertions 与 shuffled-header derangement control 证明：在 conditional CAD completion 中，错误 design-intent header 不只是无用噪声，而会通过学到的 header-to-program mapping 主动把 geometry 引向错误方向。
methodFlow: DeepCAD programs 提取五项 design-intent header
LoRA 训练 conditioned 与 unconditioned CAD code models
生成 CadQuery code 并要求实际执行
用 independent B-rep assertions 评分 geometry adherence
Derangement-trained control 隔离 mapping-dependent harm
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它直接研究 parametric CAD program completion，属于核心 3D/CAD generation；同时提醒 visual design pipeline 不应无条件信任 upstream intent header、LLM plan 或 inferred constraints。Execution-level geometry evaluation 与 wrong-signal stress test 对 CAD agents 很实用。
analysis.evidenceZh: 40% prefix 下，execution-gated adherence 从 no-header 0.425 降到 wrong text/token header 的 0.305/0.215（Table 2, pp. 10-11）；correct token header 的表面 gain 经 execution gating 从 +0.22 降到 +0.03，再以 B-rep geometry 评分降到 +0.02。Derangement interaction 在 3/3 seeds 显著，p≤0.024（Table 3, pp. 13-14）。
analysis.caveatZh: Duplicate-aware 修正后只有 38 个 unique primary programs，text-header 预注册 combined rule 只在 1/3 seeds 显著；有效 intents 主要是 polygonal/thin。结论只适用于 40% prefix completion，不能外推到 from-scratch CAD generation，也尚未在更大模型或其他 CAD languages 上复现。
analysis.motivationZh: Text-to-CAD 系统常把 design intent 当作理所当然有益的 conditioning，但 regex adherence 会把不可执行代码误判为成功，也无法区分模型是理解了 header 内容，还是只利用了 header marginal。
analysis.methodZh: 作者给 CadQuery-style programs 加五项 design-intent header，在 correct、wrong、masked 与 no-header 条件下评估 LoRA code models。输出先实际执行，再用独立 B-rep assertions 检查 geometry。另训练保持 header marginal、打乱 header-program correlation 的 derangement twin，以因果隔离 learned semantic mapping 带来的伤害。
analysis.experimentsZh: 预注册矩阵覆盖 0%/40% prefix、text/token headers 与三个 seeds。Scoring 对照包含 ungated regex、execution-gated regex 和 B-rep geometry；control 对照包含 unconditioned model 与 derangement-trained model。评估控制严谨，但模型、数据与 intent coverage 很窄，0% prefix baseline 甚至无法生成有效 CAD。
analysis.insightZh: 对 programmatic design，conditioning 的价值必须经过 executable artifact 验证；同时应把“给错信息”作为独立 stress test。保留输入分布却打乱语义映射的 derangement control，是诊断 design agent 是否真正依赖规划信号的可迁移方法。
